summary: Phase 8D Executive Dashboard tested end-to-end. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases pass (200 + all 13 required keys incl 6-month trend; month filter honored; profitability arithmetic gross_profit=revenue-hpp and gross_margin rounded to 1dp; RBAC 403 for Sales and Accounting). Frontend: Super Admin lands on /dashboard rendering data-testid=executive-dashboard; all 4 KPI groups (exec-sales/financial/profit/tax) render real IDR numbers; all 6 charts render (chart-profit-trend, chart-cashflow, chart-funnel, chart-aging, chart-rev-package, chart-sales-perf); all 6 Company Outstanding tiles (eo-unpaid/overdue/refund/commission/commpayable/tax) present; eo-unpaid navigates to /accounting and eo-refund to /approvals; exec-period-filter is an <input type=month> and re-fetch works when the value is changed. issues: Recharts logs many 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings on first render before ResponsiveContainer settles — cosmetic console noise only; charts still paint correctly. Consider setting explicit min-height on ResponsiveContainer wrappers.

critical_code_review_comments: Recharts ResponsiveContainer emits width/height=-1 warnings — add minHeight on parent divs to silence and prevent brief zero-size layout thrash.
server.py is very large (>4300 lines); Phase 8D endpoint is fine but the module should be split into routers for maintainability.
